cell_type_or_model: primary spinal astrocytes and contusive SCI tissue
assay_or_perturbation: bFGF treatment; YAP conditional deletion; RhoA inhibition; p-YAP, Ki67/PH3 and glial-scar assays
evidence_summary: RhoA was required for bFGF-induced YAP activation and astrocyte proliferation, and astrocytic YAP promoted glial-scar formation and neural regeneration after SCI.
limitations: The study does not establish the exact FGFR paralog or a direct FGF2-FGFR1-YAP molecular edge; no terminal YAP target locus is assigned here.

assay_or_perturbation: FGF2 stimulation; FGFR1 autophosphorylation; MAPK/DNA-synthesis and SPARC/PKA perturbation assays
evidence_summary: FGF2-FGFR1 signaling was linked to receptor autophosphorylation and MAPK/DNA-synthesis or differentiation-associated outputs.
limitations: Comparator models and branch-specific SPARC/PKA effects should not be transferred to SCI astrocytes or treated as a terminal TF assignment.

species: chick embryo and developmental vertebrate models
assay_or_perturbation: FGF10/FGFR2 perturbation; ETV5 chromatin occupancy; Shh enhancer and branching assays
evidence_summary: FGF10-FGFR2 signaling was associated with ETV5 activation and direct occupancy of the Shh enhancer during lung branching morphogenesis.
limitations: Developmental context; the cross-module path is not an SCI-specific claim and preserves the FGFR2 receptor-complex identity.

evidence_confidence: FGF18 treatment was associated with an FGFR-contextual ETV4/ETV5 lung-fibroblast program and branching-related output.
evidence_summary: The source does not isolate FGFR2 as the sole receptor or provide direct ETV4/ETV5 occupancy for the exact FGF18-FGFR2 row.
